issues: The portrait has slightly polished editorial lighting, but skin texture, anatomy, age, Egyptian appearance and short regulation haircut remain credible.
Identity remains consistent across expressions, profiles, wet hair, fatigue and varied lighting.
The set provides strong variety in framing, pose, clothing, setting and illumination without obvious duplicates or clothing bake-in.
Captions describe variable conditions rather than fixed facial traits.

summary: The youthful, clean-shaven Egyptian look fits Private Mostafa and the 1973 commando grooming rules. The anchor is photorealistic and the varied training set is consistent and free of material defects.
name: Karim Nour
